note: The identity of the FVC2002 corpus as it sits on the machine that issued this manifest. Every number carries a status. Two claims are kept apart on purpose and must not be conflated: that the copy is faithful to the tree it was copied from, which is VERIFIED, and that the tree is the official distribution, which is UNVERIFIED. REF-009 decision 4 is why. No image, no minutia and no pixel value is in this file or in anything it names; the checksum lists carry a digest and a file name.

root.note: Resolved as .env.example specifies, mounted read-only at /data/raw by the Makefile. The mount was checked from inside the container: the listing is the corpus, a write to /data/raw fails with Read-only file system, and a write to /data/derived succeeds.

layout.note: The distributor's own layout, kept verbatim. Doc/ holds FVC2002_results_summary.pdf; Src/ holds inc/fvc2002.h, skeletons/Enroll_XXXX.c and skeletons/Match_XXXX.c. INV-005 F-1.

bytes_total.note: Summed over every file in the tree. Of that, 451890560 bytes are the 3520 images; the remainder is the four index files, the summary PDF and the three participant skeleton sources.

provenance.note: The tree reached this machine through a redistribution and not from the organisers. This is a fact about how it arrived, and it is the reason the field below is UNVERIFIED.

copy_faithful_to_source_tree.note: robocopy /E /COPY:DAT /XJ reported 3528 files copied, 0 failed, 0 mismatched. The four index files, which are text carrying CRLF and would be the first casualties of a line-ending normalisation, digest identically before and after the copy. No symbolic link or junction exists under the target. INV-005 F-4.

correspondence_to_official_distribution.note: Every digest available here was taken from the same tree it describes, so it establishes faithfulness and cannot establish authenticity: using it for the second would be circular. Closing this needs a checksum published by the organisers, or a second copy obtained independently. INV-005 R-1, REF-009 decision 4.

value: The layout is the distribution's own, including Doc/ and Src/, and Src/ holds three participant skeleton sources.

Each database holds exactly one distinct image size across every one of its files: 388x374, 296x560, 300x300 and 288x384. DB1's agrees with the size INV-002 F-1 measured on the same subset for another purpose.
The file counts are 800 per _A subset and 80 per _B, and each is exactly the number of fingers present times the number of impressions present, with no finger or impression missing or repeated.
The index files carry 4950, 2800, 45 and 280 lines, which are exactly the pairwise counts the finger and impression counts present in the corpus give: 100*99/2, 100*(8*7/2), 10*9/2 and 10*(8*7/2).
corroboration_of_authenticity.note: Each item above was measured or computed here, over the whole corpus, and each is a property a faithful copy would have and a corrupted or substituted one probably would not. None of them is a signature, and this field is corroboration, not proof. It does not change the status of the field above. Nothing here is a comparison against a document: see attributed_but_not_read.

value: That the four image sizes above are the ones the published FVC2002 specification gives.
That the four line counts above are the comparison counts the FVC protocol defines.
attributed_but_not_read.note: Both are attributions to documents no investigation in this repository has read. They are stated separately from the field above because a comparison against an unread document is not a measurement, and putting one inside a VERIFIED field would be the exact inference REF-009 decision 4 exists to prevent. What is established here is the internal arithmetic, not the agreement with an outside authority. INV-005 F-9 records that the specification has not been read; INV-005 R-2 records that the organisers' pages could not be fetched.

publisher_checksums.note: Whether the organisers publish checksums could not be settled from here in either direction. bias.csr.unibo.it presents a certificate naming only biolab.csr.unibo.it, so a fetch fails on a hostname mismatch; biolab.csr.unibo.it returns HTTP 404 for the FVC2002 path; the Internet Archive is not reachable from this environment. A web search surfaced none, which is weak evidence of absence and no evidence of what the page says. INV-005 R-2.

index_files.note: The comparison indices the distribution ships, digested and measured but not interpreted. The protocol they define has no manifest and is not this manifest's subject. INV-005 F-7.

lines.note: Every line names two .tif files; 100 distinct names are referenced. Line endings are CRLF on every line.
Every line names two .tif files; 800 distinct names are referenced. Line endings are CRLF on every line.

roles.note: The roles below are the organisers' definition and not this project's assignment. The competition distributed fingers 1 to 100 as the benchmark evaluation set and fingers 101 to 110 to participants for parameter tuning. INV-005 F-10 measures which fingers each subset contains; that mapping is what this manifest establishes here, and the meaning of the two ranges is attributed, not derived.
roles.eval_primary: The benchmark evaluation set as the organisers defined it. A result reported from it is a benchmark result.
roles.tune: The set the organisers gave participants for parameter tuning. Legitimate for verifying that a tool behaves as its manifest records. Not a benchmark set: a result computed on it must name the set it came from. This repository's tool fixture is recorded against fvc2002/DB1_B, which is measured in INV-005 F-11 and carried in that subset's carries_the_tool_fixture field. See REF-009 decision 2.

observations.note: Properties of this corpus that a later run has to know about and that are not per-subset fields.

byte_identical_files.note: Exactly one pair in the whole corpus. Searched within each of the eight subsets and across all of them: no other pair shares a digest, and no pair spans two subsets. 3519 distinct digests over 3520 files. INV-005 F-6.

duplicate_pair_is_a_defined_comparison.note: The line '81_5.tif 81_7.tif' appears exactly once in index_a.MFR, the index of 2800 genuine comparisons, and does not appear in index_a.MFA. Since the two files are byte-identical, a deterministic extractor returns the same template for both and a deterministic matcher therefore performs a self-comparison; the determinism of the extractor in this repository's image is recorded in MAN-tools.v1.json. One of the genuine comparisons this corpus defines is a file compared with itself. INV-005 F-8.

resolution_declared_in_the_files.note: XResolution, YResolution and ResolutionUnit are absent from all 3520 TIFF headers. Every resolution_dpi field above is therefore a report and not a measurement, and nothing in this corpus can check one. INV-005 F-9.

distinct_digests.note: Over 3520 image files. The difference of one is the pair above.

not_in_this_manifest: Any image, any minutia, any pixel value. Digests, counts, dimensions, roles, statuses and file names only.

The protocol. The index files are digested and their shape is measured; what comparison they define, and whether every line names a pair that exists, is not this manifest's subject and has no manifest yet.
Any claim that a digest taken from this tree establishes where the tree came from. REF-009 decision 4.
